outcome: Childhood Autism Rating Scale (CARS) scores (symptom severity)
Denver Developmental Screening Test 2nd Edition (DDST II) scores (developmental levels including social and gross motor)
cohort: The study included 141 children aged 24-72 months diagnosed with ASD and 128 healthy children of the same age range.
finding: Children with ASD exhibited less nursing strike behavior and less eye contact during breastfeeding, with these factors, along with unintended pregnancy, being associated with the risk of ASD.
mod_finding: Higher CARS scores (indicating greater ASD symptom severity) were observed in children with ASD who had a history of vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data on current outcomes and retrospective exposures were collected when the children were aged 24-72 months.
